guide.summary: A big round colony of algae that shades the water around it.
guide.biology: Some real green algae live together in rounded colonies of many cells. In this game a whole colony is played as one creature.
guide.rules: Lives in water only and does not swim. Turns carbon dioxide into half body and half sugar, releasing oxygen, in proportion to local light. It is large, with a starting body of 5, intake up to 0.36 carbon per second and upkeep of 0.80 energy per second, so it needs plenty of mineral nutrients. It casts shade: light in a cell is multiplied by 1 ÷ (1 + the Raftball biomass in that cell and its four neighbours ÷ 10). That shade falls on every light-powered cell there, Raftballs included. Only Waterbear eats it.
guide.example: Grow a Raftball among Sunbeads and Shadeleafs and see which of them does best in its shade.
